subject: Life Skills
theme: What to do in an emergency

source.topic: Personal and Social Well-being: Safety in the home
source.subtopic: Keeping safe when home alone; knowing what to do in an emergency

show.line: In an emergency, stay calm. Call a trusted grown-up or phone for help!

rounds.prompt: Someone knocks and you are home alone. What do you do?
The police number is one zero one one one. Say it.
There is smoke in the house. What do you do?
rounds.praise: Get out and call for help!

rounds.story: Gogo falls and cannot get up. Ayo is with her. What should Ayo do?
rounds.praise: Call for help! A neighbour or an ambulance.

rounds.prompt: On the phone, say your name and your...?

hints: Stay calm and get a grown-up.
Know where your emergency number card is.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! A stranger knocks. I am alone.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: I open the door and say come in!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Never open the door when alone.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Keep the door closed. Call a grown-up!

parent_line: Knows what to do when home alone and in an emergency.
